stage_desc.pulse: Draw raw tensions from every connected source and breed candidates.
stage_desc.critic: Pre-screen, fact gate, duplicate gate, judge, feasibility floor, MAP-elites.
stage_desc.fitness: Embed survivors and re-learn taste from your decisions.
stage_desc.weave: Seed threads from the strongest survivors and deepen them one step.
